title: Report Writing
format: Title, date/place, introduction, incident summary, causes or impact, present status and conclusion.
modelAnswer:
Title: Road Accident at College Square

An accident involving a bus and a two-wheeler occurred near College Square on 18 November. The bus stopped suddenly, and the rider fell. Traffic police reached the spot quickly and cleared the road. One rider received first aid, and no serious injury was reported. The incident shows the need for careful driving and proper maintenance of the road.

title: Précis Writing
format: Read carefully, identify the central idea, remove examples and repetition, and write a coherent one-third summary.
modelAnswer: The central skill of reading is not copying words but selecting what matters. A précis requires the student to identify the main argument, remove examples and repetition, and preserve the writer's purpose. Clear language and accurate length are more important than personal comments.

title: Summary Writing
format: Identify the theme, select key points, omit details and examples, and write a short objective paragraph.
modelAnswer: Daily exercise improves physical health and mental concentration. It need not be expensive or time-consuming. Walking, cycling and simple indoor activities can be practised regularly. Consistency is more useful than occasional intense effort.

title: Translation into English
format: Understand the complete Bengali/Hindi sentence, preserve tense and meaning, and use natural Indian English.
modelAnswer: I reached the office on time and submitted the report. The officer checked the documents and asked me to wait for a few minutes.

title: Paragraph Writing
format: Topic sentence, supporting details or examples, and a clear concluding sentence.
modelAnswer: Community libraries provide quiet, affordable spaces for learning. They give students access to books and newspapers that they may not otherwise buy. Libraries also encourage reading, discussion and mutual respect. With more digital services and trained staff, they can remain valuable centres for every age group.
checklist: Open with a clear topic sentence
Use two or three supporting points
